description: This file contains unit tests for the InfoArray class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance module, specifically testing the retrieval of match criteria and parameters in the DTO.

classes.name: InfoArrayTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the InfoArray data transfer object, ensuring correct extraction of match and parameter configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes two instances of InfoArray with different configurations for use in subsequent test methods.

methods.name: testGetMatchArray
methods.description: Validates that getMatchArray returns the correct match criteria array for each InfoArray instance.

methods.name: testGetParameterArray
methods.description: Checks that getParameterArray returns the expected list of parameters, or null if parameters are not defined.
